lines.en: The Armored Beast comes on in heavy strides.

lines.zh: 它的甲片互相摩擦作响
lines.en: Its plates grind against one another.
The ground quivers at each step.
Its head stays low, shoulders hunched.
It circles you without stopping.
Its tail swings behind.

lines.zh: 它的爪子把土抓得翻开
lines.en: Its claws turn up the soil.
It surges, then eases.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸在甲缝里出来
lines.en: Its breath escapes through the plates.
It stops only when close.

lines.zh: 它侧过身，甲片全亮出来
lines.en: It turns broadside, all plates showing.
One stride takes it to your flank.

lines.zh: 覆甲恶兽站着，一动不动
lines.en: The Armored Beast stands without moving.
Its plates open and close.
A dull red shows between them.
It shifts its weight across.
A sound rolls in its throat.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在地上按了按
lines.en: Its claws press the ground.
Its head cocks.
Old scores cover its plates.
It shakes its body.
Plates clatter against each other.
The Armored Beast raises its head at you.
Its eyes sit behind the plate gaps.

lines.zh: 甲片全张，我把你量了一遍。
lines.en: Plates flared; I measured you head to foot.
It steps in, plates flaring.
It lifts a claw.
And lowers it slowly.
Its breathing deepens.
It seems to weigh you.
It backs half a step, still facing you.
Its head rises higher.

lines.zh: 覆甲恶兽晃了一下，退了半步
lines.en: The Armored Beast sways and gives half a step.
A pale line shows on a plate.
Its breathing stumbles a beat.

lines.zh: 它用爪子按了按受伤处
lines.en: A claw presses the wound.
Its roar drops a register.
It resets its weight low.
Its plates snap open and shut faster.

lines.zh: 它低头看了一眼，又抬头
lines.en: It glances down, then up.
It gives half a step, and no more.
Its eyes stay locked on you.

lines.zh: 覆甲恶兽看了一眼你手上的东西
lines.en: The Armored Beast glances at what you hold.
A claw probes at it.
It pins the item to the ground.
It sniffs it.
Food does not hurry it.
It nudges the item back to your feet.
It does not eat; it just guards it.
It raises its head.

lines.zh: 它对你能给什么没兴趣
lines.en: What you can offer does not interest it.
It turns to you, waiting for you to move.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，像撞一排铁片
lines.en: You hit it like a row of iron plates.
It does not shift.
A claw moves you back half a step.

lines.zh: 它的甲片在你手上刮了一下
lines.en: A plate edge scrapes your hand.
It looks down to see if you fell.
It angles slightly aside.
Its tail sweeps your leg.
The ground dips under it.
It settles, weight low.
It takes no offence.
Two beasts stand abreast.
Their plates flare at once.
The dull red joins between them.
They knock shoulder plates.
The sound rolls around.
Their breathing syncs.
They press their heads together.
The plates fold shut.
They stand back to back.
Each guarding a side.

lines.zh: 覆甲恶兽用爪子拾起东西
lines.en: The Armored Beast picks the item up with a claw.
It holds it before a plate gap.
It turns it twice and stows it under the plates.
What it cannot use, it casts away.
It barely bends to take it.
It pins the item under a claw.

lines.zh: 它把几样东西码在一起
lines.en: It stacks several items together.
One look and it is stowed.

lines.zh: 它的动作沉，却没有多余
lines.en: Heavy motion, nothing wasted.
Done, it straightens again.

lines.zh: 覆甲恶兽的甲片全张开了
lines.en: Every plate flares open.
The dull red brightens.
It drops its body low.

lines.zh: 它的喉咙里滚出一声吼
lines.en: A roar rolls in its throat.
Its stamp cracks the ground.
It starts closing in.
Its claws spread wide.
Its tail goes rigid.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸变成短促的喷气
lines.en: Its breathing turns to short blasts.
It locks you dead centre.
Its plates flare again.
It could spring at any moment.
It rears up suddenly.
That roar blows the dust outward.
Its shadow presses on you.
It has already begun to charge.

lines.zh: 覆甲恶兽在你周围绕圈
lines.en: The Armored Beast circles you.
Its steps quicken.
It probes at your flank.
Its plates stay open.
It stops and blasts out a note.
It waits for you to give ground.
It sinks lower and lower.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在地上刨出沟
lines.en: Its claws dig furrows.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一下一下地拍
lines.en: Its tail beats the ground.
It has found its charge line.
It starts its run-up.
This time it will not stop.
Its plates lock tight.
It roars and bears down.
The ground shakes under it.
It is faster than it looks.
It is close enough to reach you.
It throws its whole weight across.
It lifts the plates on its shoulders.
Its head turns with your movement.
The Armored Beast slams a claw down.
A shoulder plate rams your chest.
It drives its head in and pushes you back.
Its tail lashes your waist.
It bites your armour and wrenches.
It leaps and comes down claws first.

lines.zh: 它的甲片在你手臂上刮过
lines.en: Its plates rake your arm.
A roar drives you back a step.
The miss turns into a spin.
It comes down with all its weight.
Its stomp costs you your footing.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在地面划出深痕
lines.en: Its claws score deep lines.

lines.zh: 它退开半步，重新张开甲
lines.en: It backs half a step, plates opening.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸粗重，眼睛没离开
lines.en: Breathing hard, it never looks away.

lines.zh: 它用甲缘削过你的手臂
lines.en: A plate edge shears past your arm.
A claw stamps at your foot.
It drives you back against the stone.
A toss of its head sweeps you aside.
It withdraws, plates closing.

lines.zh: 它的吼声在你耳边炸开
lines.en: Its roar bursts beside your ear.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里漏出热气，先震一下。
lines.en: Heat leaks from my seams; the ground shudders.

lines.zh: 覆甲恶兽从尘里走出来
lines.en: The Armored Beast walks out of the dust.
Its plates flare open one by one.
The dull red between them glows.
It lifts its head and looks this way.
It shakes the dirt off its neck.
The plates clatter harshly.

lines.zh: 它朝你的方向迈了一步
lines.en: It takes one step your way.
Its footfall lands heavily.
It stops, square to you.
It roars.
Loose soil falls from the sides.

lines.zh: 甲片被烧得发烫，它甩身退开
lines.en: Its plates heat and it shies away.

lines.zh: 落地时它一膝磕进土里
lines.en: It lands and a knee drives into the soil.

lines.zh: 水淹过甲缝，它奋力上顶
lines.en: Water reaches its seams; it drives upward.

lines.zh: 冲击把它推得滑退数格
lines.en: The blast slides it back several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭在甲面上弹开，只留一点白
lines.en: An arrow rings off a plate, leaving a pale spot.
Odd force slips between plates; it growls.

lines.zh: 饿着打，它的动作慢了半拍
lines.en: Fighting hungry, its timing slips.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着甲片走，火花四溅
lines.en: Lightning crawls the plates, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 虚空拽它，爪子抓进土里
lines.en: The void pulls; its claws dig in.
